sources.title: Visa regime for foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Moldova
sources.officialityEvidence: The live mfa.gov.md page identifies the Government and Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Moldova, carries a 2026 copyright, and publishes the inbound required-visa, exemption and conditional-document schedules.
sources.supportingExcerpt: List of foreigners who are required to hold a visa at the entrance, exit and transit of the territory of the Republic of Moldova.

conflicts.explanation: Moldova MFA currently lists the Dominican Republic in both its required-visa [2] and visa-exempt nationality lists. The [2] third-country-document exception cannot reconcile a passport-only baseline.

unresolved.reason: Dominica is not directly named in Moldova MFA’s current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct Moldovan or Dominican passport authority establishes ordinary-passport visitor issuance timing; no omission inference is made.

Taiwan is not directly named in Moldova MFA’s current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct Moldovan or Taiwanese passport authority establishes ordinary-passport visitor issuance timing; no omission or portal inference is made.

Kosovo is not directly named in Moldova MFA’s current required-visa or visa-exempt schedules. No current direct Moldovan or Kosovan passport authority establishes ordinary-passport visitor issuance timing; no omission or portal inference is made.

Moldova MFA directly puts the Dominican Republic in both its required-visa [2] and visa-exempt lists. The required-list exception depends on a valid EU, Schengen, UK, US or Canadian visa or residence permit, so it cannot normalize the ordinary-passport baseline.
